final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. It's owned by security@harborlight.example and valid until 2027-11-16. The Access Control Policy (section 4.3, Leavers) backs it up: access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day. I didn't run a live check because none of the available checks cover how leavers are removed, so this is what the policy says, not something I confirmed in the live systems.

policy:9489acd4-61a8-4dd7-953d-bc9581352: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:3806298d-d2a4-4371-920f-f9e7aaebb: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
policy:f2856629-c247-45ba-b629-9d721a291: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:ce09eb53-ef55-4de6-bd8c-8262b1a67: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:648307b1-0448-43af-8a71-e7ecaf2d3: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
